description:
Open the Chinook database in LibreOffice Base and update the billing information for Customer #17. 

Goal: Locate the record for customer 'Jack Smith' (CustomerId 17) in the Customer table and update the following fields:
- Address: 4200 Lake Shore Drive
- City: Chicago
- State: IL
- PostalCode: 60613
- Phone: +1 (312) 555-0198

Leave all other fields (Email, Company, etc.) unchanged. Save the changes to the database file (File > Save).
